review/independent.go.patch:
--- a/review/independent.go
+++ b/review/independent.go
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 	"encoding/json"
 	"errors"
 	"fmt"
+	"io"
 	"maps"
 	"os"
 	"path/filepath"
@@ -206,6 +207,9 @@
 	if err := dec.Decode(&s); err != nil {
 		return s, err
 	}
+	if _, err := dec.Token(); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
+		return s, errors.New("review session has data after its JSON value")
+	}
 	return s, nil
 }
